## AI Booking Assistant (live calendar availability)
Chat endpoint for a clinic/salon website or messaging channel. Reads the business row from Google Sheets, asks Google Calendar free/busy for real open slots, lets the model offer only those times, then writes the booking to Sheets + Calendar and pings Telegram (extra alert for high-value treatments).
**Plug in:** OpenAI, Google Sheets + Calendar credentials, YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
**Test:** POST {"message":"Can I book a cleaning tomorrow at 10?"} to the webhook.
Ran in production for our own demo clinic.
